mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are enjoying clear skies near Verona City Hall. If you look up tonight at 7:40 PM, you might catch the space station traveling from the west-southwest over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Madison. It will be a chilly night with a low of 48 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

In city news, police were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on Wednesday for a burglary in progress. Officers located 19 year old Luis Aragon-Zaring, who was taken to the hospital for an injury before being booked into the Dane County Jail for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after a handgun was recovered.

Today is a big day for the city with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival happening downtown. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga classes start tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and next week features trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, along with the downtown farmer's market.

In our weekly report, we want to inform you of an incident that took place on Wednesday, September 10th, involving a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way that led to a successful arrest by local officers.
Make sure to stop by for today's flavor of the day, Caramel Cashew. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 11:00 PM tonight.
